title: Key Achievements of the Labour - Progressive Coalition Government
content:
31 July 2003

Key Achievements of the Labour - Progressive Coalition Government

  • Helen Clark
Prime Minister

The Labour – Progressive Coalition government was elected in July 2002 with a mandate to continue to work in partnerships with all sectors to rebuild our nation and to become a country known for our innovation, our skills, and
our lifestyle.
